previous_statement: For homogeneous a∈A_n with n>0, degree preservation gives Δ(a)∈⊕_{i=0}^n A_i⊗A_{n-i}. Because A_0=F·1, the endpoint components have forms b⊗1 and 1⊗c. The counit identities (id⊗ε)Δ(a)=a=(ε⊗id)Δ(a) force b=a=c; every remaining summand has both tensor factors of positive degree. Thus Δ(a)=a⊗1+1⊗a+Σ_i a'_i⊗a''_i with |a'_i|,|a''_i|>0, exactly condition (2) of GT-hatcher-AT-hopf-algebra-definition.
new_statement: For homogeneous a∈A_n with n>0, degree preservation gives Δ(a)∈⊕_{i=0}^n A_i⊗A_{n-i}, while the graded counit ε:A→F vanishes on A_i for i>0. Because A_0=F·1, the endpoint components have forms b⊗1 and 1⊗c. Applying the counit identities (id⊗ε)Δ(a)=a=(ε⊗id)Δ(a), all positive-degree terms vanish and the endpoint coefficients are forced to be b=a=c. Every remaining summand has both tensor factors of positive degree. Thus Δ(a)=a⊗1+1⊗a+Σ_i a'_i⊗a''_i with |a'_i|,|a''_i|>0, exactly condition (2) of GT-hatcher-AT-hopf-algebra-definition.
